Au marché, on compte les sacs échangés p: At the market, the sacks exchanged are counted with notches on a stick. Nobody writes yet, but nobody gets cheated any more.
On y tient les réserves de l'île sur des: The island's reserves are kept here on clay tablets. At last we know what is left in the granaries.
Il retrace les parcelles quand le ruisse: He redraws the plots when the stream has overflowed. Everyone gets their field back, to the step.
Règle et compas : on y trace les plans d: Ruler and compass: the plans of the island's buildings are drawn here before the first stone is laid.
Il cercle ses tonneaux sans gâcher un po: He hoops his barrels without wasting an inch of iron, because he knows what the round of a circle is worth. The casks no longer leak.
On y pose les dettes en baguettes noires: Debts are laid out here in black rods and credits in red. The market's accounts come out right, even when money is owed.
La case vide du registre: The empty box in the register
Le greffier a enfin un signe pour dire «: The clerk finally has a sign to say "nothing". Empty granaries are no longer mistaken for forgotten ones.
Héritages, parts de récolte, eau du cana: Inheritances, shares of the harvest, canal water: the unknown is set down here and the recipe unrolled. Families quarrel much less.
Dix chiffres et le calcul à la plume rem: Ten digits and pen-and-ink arithmetic replace the tokens. The port's counting house handles three ships where it used to handle one.
Trois sacs pour deux pièces, donc combie: Three sacks for two coins, so how much for seven? The stallholder answers before you have finished the question.
Deux savants s'affrontent en public à co: Two scholars face off in public with equations. The whole island bets, and a few understand.
Chaque barque verse un peu, et celle qui: Each boat pays in a little, and the one that sinks is reimbursed. The odds have been calculated, so people dare to go further.
Un gros livre où multiplier revient à ad: A big book in which multiplying comes down to adding. The pilot fixes his position in ten minutes instead of a night.
On y calcule la pente d'une rampe, le dé: Here they calculate the slope of a ramp, the flow of a canal, the shape of a tank. Engineers no longer go by guesswork.
Le plan des sept ponts: The plan of the seven bridges
Le facteur y trace sa tournée pour ne pa: The postman plots his round here so as to pass everywhere only once. The mail arrives before noon.
Naissances, récoltes, fièvres : on compt: Births, harvests, fevers: everything is counted, and you see what nobody saw. The town hall can finally plan for winter.
Sur un globe, les règles du plan ne tien: On a globe, the rules of the plane no longer hold. Students come out with maps of the island that are finally right.
Des interrupteurs qu'on combine en « et: Switches combined into "and", "or", "not". Disputes are settled here by wiring them.
Une maquette où il reste toujours une ch: A model where there is always one room left. Visitors lose their certainties here and gain a taste for proofs.
Elle lit, écrit, avance d'une case et re: It reads, writes, moves one square and starts again. It shows students what a machine can do, and what none ever will.
